title: AION 2 Database: Items, Skills and Character Lookup
description: Find AION 2 item, skill, quest and drop databases, choose the right region, and distinguish character lookup from SteamDB product information.
summary: Choose a database by the question you need to answer: equipment, skill details, quest steps, a character profile or Steam product records.
quickAnswer: Use gaming.tools or MetaBot for Global item, skill and quest records. AION2 Hub adds Global and KR/TW item filters. For a player, use character lookup; SteamDB covers the Steam product rather than in-game drops.

steps.label: Choose the region
steps.description: Start with Global, KR or TW; language alone does not identify the game version.

steps.label: Open the exact record
steps.description: Match the name, faction, item type and level requirement.

steps.label: Follow its acquisition links
steps.description: Check the quest, monster, chest or recipe rather than stopping at the stat preview.

steps.label: Confirm in game
steps.description: Check that the content is open and the reward or recipe exists before spending currency.
